notes.title: The Armageddon Update - art, new romance, and quality update!
notes.content:
In preparation for the Armageddon Expo in Auckland NZ, we are re-releasing Prince of Cats as The Nine Lives of Nim: Fortune's Fool. 

Watch this space - next month we will release the fully voice acted update!

In today's update:
- Art fully upgraded to 16:9 ratio!
- New romance plotlines added!
- Name change to the game
- Minor quality updates

notes.title: Introducing The Nine Lives of Nim: Fortune's Fool!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34840399/26a1e82bd45c37b9851f531cc304dd3ba0f3f41a.jpg

In order to secure a unique trademark for the game formerly known as Prince of Cats, allow me to reintroduce you to your old favourite: The Nine Lives of Nim: Fortune's Fool!

Why is this happening? Well, watch this space. There will be more news in the coming months of...
- an update coming to Steam! Such as 16:9 art and full voice acting!
- ports to consoles!!
- translations into multiple languages!

Nine Lives - does that mean... eight more games? Maybe ;) ... watch this space!
